meta.title: 2026 World Cup replay dataset
meta.source_name: FIFA match schedule, fixtures and results
meta.datetime_note: The source lists local or Eastern times inconsistently. Offline seed datetimes use 12:00 UTC on the verified match date and must not be treated as exact kick-off times.
meta.model_input_note: strength_rank values are experimental seed inputs for this fan model. They are not official FIFA rankings.
meta.license_note: Facts are transcribed for attribution and replay. No FIFA logos, photography, video, or other protected media are included.
meta.product_positioning: Replay the 2026 World Cup, compare the model with actual outcomes, and explore alternative predictions.
meta.disclaimer: Independent experimental fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by FIFA.

model.name: Heuristic Poisson replay model
model.method: Experimental team-strength and form inputs estimate goal rates; a Poisson score matrix produces three-way probabilities.
model.limitations: Seed strength values are estimates, many contextual fields use neutral defaults, probabilities are not calibrated betting advice, and replay evaluation is not a prospective trial.
